errors.evidence: The description incorrectly maps the colors to their corresponding percentage values. The correct mapping shown in the figure is: оранжево (orange) is 57.1%, синьо (blue) is 23.8%, and червено (red) is 19%. The description also misidentifies the red slice as yellow ('жълто').

errors.text_span: Секторите са подредени по величините на процентите
errors.evidence: The statement that the sectors are ordered by the magnitude of their percentages is incorrect. Visually, the sectors are not arranged in descending or ascending order of size. The largest slice (orange, 57.1%) is followed clockwise by the smallest (red, 19%) and then the middle one (blue, 23.8%).

errors.text_span: като синият сектор е най-голям, следван от оранжевия и жълтия
errors.evidence: This clause incorrectly identifies the relative sizes of the sectors. The largest sector is the orange one (57.1%), not the blue one (23.8%).
